upgrade_config: upgrade a detectron2 config CfgNode from its current version to the latest or a specified version
downgrade_config: downgrade a detectron2 config CfgNode from its current version to an older specified version
guess_version: guess the version of a partial detectron2 config that is missing the VERSION field
rename_config_keys: rename old detectron2 config keys to new names using the internal _rename helper function
review_ConverterV2: review the ConverterV2 class that handles bulk config key renames before the public release
